set policy-options policy-statement MULT.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from route-filter [parameter3] exact

set policy-options policy-statement MULT.explanation: 配置策略语句，精确匹配指定的路由过滤器。

parameters.name: route-filter
